|lore=Wookiee '''smuggler''' from Kashyyyk. Over 200 years old. Top-notch mechanic and pilot. Jabba has large bounty on this “walking carpet.” Friends call him Chewie… or Fuzzball.
|game_text=Power +1 at same location as Han. Adds 2 to power of any starship he pilots. On Millennium Falcon, also adds 1 to maneuver. Your vehicles, starships and droids at same site go to Used Pile (rather than Lost Pile) when they are 'hit'.
|joke="Walking carpet" is Princess Leia's insult in ''Star Wars''<ref name="imsdb-anh">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Star Wars: A New Hope script], IMSDb.
